BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Oculasignio!!
Guys!!
Oh, the inhabitants of another world, you made\nit here!
How did you know that we came from another world?!
I knew about it as my fellows that came back from\nyour world shared the information with me...\nYou got here much faster than I thought though...
Well, lemme return the pain you've caused my\nfellows!
Right, right!! You're kidnapping the Eumanos to\nlure us here, right?! Now we're already here,\nso let them go!
You wish! They were helping you to destroy the new\nfortress I'd worked so hard to build. I'm gonna\nfeed them to my minions after I'm done with you.
Oh wow, talking arrogantly like that won't get you\nanywhere! We haven't even started the fight.\nJust so you know we aren't planning to lose!
Stupid twerps!!
Ugh?!
Are you guys okay?!
Yeah, I guess.\nThanks for coming to save us!
Yikes!!
You and your cunning cheeky act is unforgivable!!
N-no way...I can't believe such feeble creatures\nbeat me...
A crystal with liquid in it is here too.\nCould it be the characteristic of the Coenubia in\nthis world...
What's this? Umm...the Coenubia in this world...\nOh well, it's beautiful but maybe it's dangerous.\nLet's not touch it.
Phew~, since we were able to destroy Coenubia's\nstronghold and the thing that built it, I guess\nthat's one less thing to worry about.
Was the figure seen on Mt. Vulcani a Coenubia?
What? Ooh, you mean the suspicious figure?\nIt must have been a Coenubia, don't you think so?\nOtherwise, what else could it be...
! Can you guys please come see this?!
I wonder what's over there...
I don't think that thing forms naturally...\nIt could be related to Coenubia.\nWe should check it out, shouldn't we?
Hey, you're the captain!\nYou decide!
A-all right!! Let's check out the crater!\nLet's go everyone!
